bills.challenge_note: Lo mthethosivivinywa upheha inselelo yomthethosisekelo (Art. IV §5.3, Path 1). Ukusidlulisa ngaphathi kwesikhathi sesixazululo kuvala inselelo.
bills.cultural_gloss: Ukuvota ukuvuma (F-LEG-028) kuvula isinqumo sekhamu elineiningi elikhethekile. Isikhungo esibalulwe asinalo amandla — ukuvuma kuwukuhlonipha — kanti irekhodi lakhiwa kuphela uma ikhamu livuma.
bills.empty_none: Alikho imithethosivivinywa eyethulwe kulesi sikhathi — noma yimuphi ilungu lingethula (F-LEG-003).
bills.hint_law_text: Umbhalo oboshayo — unenguqulo lapho kwethulwa (v1), ulungiswa kuphela ngezinhlelo ezamukelekile.
bills.hint_proposed_value: Kuqinisekisiwe ngokuphila ngokwemingcele eqinile — futhi futhi ngaphambi kokuvota nangokwenziwa umthetho.
bills.hint_scale: Angeke kudlule igunya laleli isishayamthetho — isinqumo esingumzali singabopha izindawo zegunya zomvoti ezibalulwe; kuqinisekisiwe injini ngokwemigomo yonke. Kumi lapho kwethulwa (Art. V §4).
bills.hint_scope: Isigaba C sikhombisa izikhala zobulungiswa esisungulwayo ngokwethembeka; shiya isikhala ukuze kube yisimo esijwayelekile.
bills.hint_setting_key: Isilungiselelo somthethosisekelo esilungiseka lo mthethosivivinywa osishintshayo.
bills.hint_setting_locked: Kukhethwe kusengaphambili ohlu lwezilungiselelo — ikhilfo livaliwe.
bills.intro: Wonke umthethosivivinywa uveza isibalo sawo (iziphi izindawo zegunya eziboshwe) nobude (izinga liyiphi inkantolo ezwa imibango) lapho kwethulwa. Izinqumo zidlula ngeningi lalo lonke ilungu elisebenza, kanti izinhlobo zezinqumo ezithile zidinga iningi elikhethekile.
bills.introduction_gloss: Noma yimuphi ilungu elihleli kuleli khamu lingethula umthethosivivinywa (F-LEG-003) — awunalo isihlalo lapha. Ukufundwa kuyisenzo somphakathi: imisebenzi yesishayamthetho yirekhodi lomphakathi · Art. II §2.
bills.lifecycle_gloss: Amakhamu amabili adlulisela kuphela lapho ikomiti NEkhama ngalinye kuvuma ngokohlobo lwayo (Art. V §3 · ledger #q7); ukuphila kwalo kusebenzisa imiphumela yinjini yokuvota.

bills.preflight_bad_title: Calelwe ngaphambi kokuvota — ngaphandle kwemingcele eqinile.
bills.preflight_ok_body: Iya ngaphambili ekuhambeni komthethosivivinywa · F-LEG-031 · WF-LEG-14 · Art. VII.

committee_detail.about_1: Ikomiti nquma ngeningi yabo bonke amalungu ayo; ukuvota okudlulile kushintsha umthethosivivinywa kuya ku
committee_detail.about_2: , okuyisimo esikodwa kuphela lapho ukudlulisela kuka F-CHR-003 kusihlalo kungakusa phansi kwehlalo. I-engine iqinisekisa lokhu ohlangothini lwe-server — inkinobho engasebenzi iwukwethembeka, hhayi umngcele.
committee_detail.agenda_hint: Izinhlelo zekomiti azinayo ikhanda elishiwo yi-engine — ukubuyekezwa okuphuthumayo kuwumsebenzi weseshini phansi kwehlalo (Art. II §2).
committee_detail.bills_scope: Le mithethosivivinywa nemibiko ingeyekomiti yonke. Ukulalelwa nobufakazi obubonakala lapha kungokuhlangana okukhethiwe.

committee_detail.intro_base: Izizwa zekomiti ziyirekhodi lomphakathi: ubufakazi, amavoti amalungu nezincazelo, kanye nemibiko yonke ishicilelwa (WF-SYS-03). Ikomiti yanquma ngeningi LAWO wonke amalungu ayo — hhayi kuphela lawo akhona
committee_detail.intro_bicameral: , kanti kuleli gumbi elinemiga emibili, uhlobo lwesihlalo ngasinye kumele livume ngokuzimela esigabeni sekomiti (Art. V §3 · irekhodi #q7)

committee_detail.reports_filed_by: Imibiko ifayilwa usihlalo — noma umlingisi lapho usihlalo engenalo (F-CHR-004 · R-12/R-13). Umzimba wepoti ushicilela irekhodi lomphakathi.

committee_detail.vote_opens: Ukuvota kwekomiti kuqala ngokwamukelwa komnyakazo wokudlulisela (WF-LEG-06) — iningi lAKHO KHO NKE amalungu ekomiti, hhayi lawo akhona · Art. II §4.
committees.about: Ukubekwa ekomitini akuncikizeli eqenjini: ilungu ngalinye lihlela amakhomiti ngokulandelana; ukubekwa kuhlonipha ukulandelana kwezinga; ukulingana kuxazululwa ngomnikazi wesihlalo onenani levoti elikhulu ngemva kokulungisa ama-quota. Lokhu kugcina ukumela okulingana okukhiqizwe ukhetho lwe-STV ngenkathi kwenza ukubekwa kungancikizeli kunoma isiphi isigaba seqembu.

emergency_powers.about: Zonke izinhlelo zokuqinisekisa zenzeka NGAPHAMBI KOKUVOTA: uhlu lwemizathu evaliwe, isilinganiso esingaphezu kwezinsuku ezingu-90, ukuhlola indawo yegunya, kanye nezidingo zezindlela ziyaqala ukunqandwa ngaphambi kokuba kuvotwe — imigqa yokunqandwa iyirekhodi elibonakala kumsebenzisi. Umugqa wamandla kanye nokubala phansi kwaso CLK-03 kuba khona kuphela ekwamukelweni kweningi elikhethekile.
emergency_powers.area_hint: Ukuqinisekisa komshini: indawo ≤ igunya laleli shayamthetho — izindawo zegunya ezizimele noma ezitholakala ngaphansi kwayo kuphela.

emergency_powers.intro: Amandla esimo esiphuthumayo akhona ngezizathu ezimbili kuphela — inhlekelele yemvelo nokuhlasela kwangempela. Adinga iningi elikhethekile, asebenza izinsuku ezingu-90 kakhulu, angabuyekezwa ubulungiswa noma nini, aphele ngokuzenzakalela, futhi angeke aphazamise ukhetho, izikhathi zomsebenzi, noma inkantolo. Amandla ayo yonke asebenzayo ayisihloko sokuqala kuyo yonke isikhathi somsebenzi.
emergency_powers.invoke_gloss: Isicelo sifayilwa ilungu elisebenza (F-LEG-024, R-09) futhi samukelwe kuphela iningi elikhethekile lalo lonke ilungu elisebenzayo. Zonke izimemezelo, ukuvuselelwa, nokuphela kushicilelwa irekhodi lomphakathi — izakhamuzi zifunda le dashibhodi ngaso sonke isikhathi.
